bundles.rationale: The positive rule classifies an express confusion between two concepts as ambiguity. The default is none only without an explicit defect cue; attribution-error is excluded because nothing is assigned to the wrong source or object.

The positive rule assigns a direct attack on a route premise or inference to the attacked central bridge. The default narrower subsidiary applies only when no central or motion bridge is advanced; alternatives is excluded because self-control is used to rebut sourcehood rather than independently establish forward-looking responses.

bundles.evidenceText: not having it wouldn't take it away from you
bundles.rationale: The positive rule assigns this direct attack on the claimed link between beyond-control conditions and responsibility to the central sourcehood bridge. The default narrower subsidiary applies only absent central or motion contact; indeterminacy is excluded because libertarian freedom is used to rebut the central inference, not independently to establish the physical-indeterminacy bridge.
